trims.notes: Zigwheels (June 2024) quotes 637 hp; Porsche Indonesia 470 kW / 639 PS overboost. Zigwheels: 240 kW DC, '80% in 21 min'. Macan Electric 4 and Turbo launched in Indonesia June 2024 (Eurokars), 'from Rp2.45 billion off the road' (no OTR published, so price left out); the RWD Macan Electric, 4S and GTS appear on the Porsche Indonesia site later (launch dates not confirmed). Range is Porsche Indonesia's 'ECE' figure (WLTP 'TBA' on the site), so range_standard left out. Power is the overboost figure; 0-100 with Launch Control. Recorded as model year 2025 (current site configuration). Motor type, usable battery (95 kWh), 800 V architecture, AC/DC power, DC 10-80% time, dimensions (width excl. mirrors), kerb weight (DIN), boot and frunk from the Malaysian spec (Porsche technical data issued at Porsche Malaysia's launch, December 2024). Chemistry (NMC811), nominal voltage, connectors and V2L from the European spec (ev-database.org).
trims.notes_id: Zigwheels (Juni 2024) menyebut 637 hp; Porsche Indonesia 470 kW / 639 PS overboost. Zigwheels: DC 240 kW, '80% dalam 21 menit'. Macan Electric 4 dan Turbo diluncurkan di Indonesia Juni 2024 (Eurokars), 'mulai Rp2,45 miliar off the road' (tidak ada harga OTR, sehingga harga dikosongkan); Macan Electric RWD, 4S, dan GTS muncul belakangan di situs Porsche Indonesia (tanggal peluncuran belum terkonfirmasi). Jarak tempuh adalah angka 'ECE' versi Porsche Indonesia (WLTP tertulis 'TBA' di situs), sehingga range_standard dikosongkan. Tenaga adalah angka overboost; 0-100 dengan Launch Control. Dicatat sebagai model year 2025 (konfigurasi situs saat ini). Jenis motor, baterai usable (95 kWh), arsitektur 800 V, daya AC/DC, waktu DC 10-80%, dimensi (lebar tanpa spion), berat kosong (DIN), bagasi, dan frunk dari spesifikasi Malaysia (data teknis Porsche pada peluncuran Porsche Malaysia, Desember 2024). Kimia baterai (NMC811), tegangan nominal, konektor, dan V2L dari spesifikasi Eropa (ev-database.org).
